input.summary: Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript following the provided architecture and OpenAPI spec. Files include: event-bus (in-memory pub/sub), services for users, projects, tasks, comments, notifications (each in its own file), a router handling all HTTP routes, a main entry to start the server, and a demo script that starts a server on port 3001 and exercises all features (users, project, membership, tasks, assignment, status changes, comments, notifications). All data is in-memory, only Node.js built-ins used, services communicate solely via the event bus. Added tsconfig and dev dependencies; verified compilation with `npx tsc --noEmit`.
